svg.aria-label: tavily_search: 4 results with title, url and a ~500-char snippet. Usually the first call of a turn. tavily_extract: The full page as clean markdown. For when a snippet is too thin for a proper quote. One place for the knobs: Both come from langchain-tavily (https://pypi.org/project/langchain-tavily/). Retrieval knobs live in debate/tools.py: max_results=4, search_depth="basic", include_answer=False. Clean close at the cap: The loop forces one clean close with the tools still bound and tool_choice={"type": "none"}. Anthropic rejects a history with tool_use blocks when no tools are defined. Tool errors do not crash the debate: They surface as ToolMessage(content="Tool error: ...") and stay visible in both tracers. The rate-limit day is not hidden
